extracted.name: Coriander paratha
ingredient_lines: Fresh finely chopped coriander leaves a cup
instruction_lines: Take all-purpose flour and add salt little oil into and a cup of coriander leaves finely chopped.
Then make a dough of it.
Then make parathas of this dough. You can apply butter on paratha also for more taste.
